title: Peddy got turned into a FROG?
custom_script:
# Scene: World of Wonders
Peddy: {wow} Look at these glowing *mushrooms* near the river bank! {pick:mushroom} [excited, point, excited, pop]
Teddy: {sniff} Wait! Do not eat those, they look *weird*! {step-back} [scared, think, whisper, rustle]
Peddy: {eat} {gasp} {oops} Oh no, my hands are turning green! {shock} [surprised, fall, shout, splash]
# Time skip: Three seconds later…
# Scene: World of Wonders
Teddy: {haan} Peddy?! Where did you go?! You are a tiny *frog* now! {gasp} [surprised, point, shout, gasp]
Peddy: {jump} {frog} Ribbit ribbit! Help me, Teddy! {cry} [sad, dance, excited, boing]
Teddy: {facepalm} I told you not to eat *magic* things! {sigh} [sad, shrug, calm, fail]
# Time skip: Meanwhile by the pond…
# Scene: World of Wonders
Peddy: {jump} {pond} Look out, I am jumping into the *pond*! {swim:pond} [happy, jump, excited, splash]
Teddy: {run} Wait for me! Do not catch any *flies* without me! {chase} [surprised, run, excited, footsteps]
Peddy: {laugh} {frog} Ribbit! Being a *frog* is actually super fun! {yay} [happy, dance, excited, boing]
Teddy: {catch:frog} {hug} Okay, but you are walking home on two *legs* later! {smile} [happy, hug, excited, magic]
